tools.name: kimi_web_search
tools.description: 用于展示网页标题、摘要、链接列表或找官网，默认include_content=false；用户明确采集正文供自行加工时才用true。选中本连接器的普通联网问答、事实核查、研究或总结直接用kimi_web_search_pro，不先Basic试探，也不为同一信息需求重复原生搜索。不能使用站点/日期过滤；明确只用Basic却要求过滤时说明冲突。只读按次计费，单次批准，不自动重试。

tools.name: kimi_web_search_pro
tools.description: 选中本连接器时，普通联网问答、事实核查、研究、总结和RAG材料直接使用Pro，即使没有站点或时间过滤；不要先Basic或并行原生搜索。仅按用户明确要求设置sites(最多5，OR)及time_window；不得擅自增加过滤。返回关联真实URL的正文chunks，缺正文或截断须说明，score仅同次查询相对相关性。仅在还需某页当前正文时对结果URL另提Fetch，不声称历史快照。只读按次计费，单次批准，失败不自动重试/换接口。

tools.name: kimi_web_fetch
tools.description: 读取用户给定且明确要求阅读的公开URL，或在用户要求核对当前正文时读取先前搜索结果的同一URL，不为已知URL先搜索。URL仅为举例/线索不等于读取意图。返回提取的Markdown，可截断，不保证完整网页/历史快照，不提供登录态或JS控制。只读按次计费，另行单次批准，失败不自动重试。

semantics.emptySearch: results=[] and truncated=false are successful empty search; failures are error outputs.
semantics.emptyFetch: Blank markdown returns no_content, never successful empty content.
semantics.truncation: Measure the complete serialized MCP result, including duplicate text content and structuredContent. Preserve UTF-8 boundaries and source order. Clip markdown or snippets/list tail with truncated=true; never clip URLs. Reject if necessary metadata alone cannot fit.
semantics.credentials: Reuse the existing Host-loaded Kimi model-key snapshot through the market-broker-control anonymous startup pipe. No separate Keyring configuration, source-file lookup in the worker, or second persistent secret. The credential is provider-scoped, not tied to a retired model ID. Fixed api.moonshot.cn API destination; no redirect and no user base URL. Target URL is a request parameter only. Local preparation grants no model execution or tool-call approval.
semantics.qualification: Local preparation reuses the configured Kimi model credential and fixed canonical descriptors; no /models, inference or Search/Fetch call. It establishes current local invocation support only, not supplier authentication, entitlement, balance or successful retrieval and makes no pricing guarantee. Actual calls keep task selection and single-use approval. No automatic Search/Fetch probe.
semantics.output: inputSchema/outputSchema come from this source. Success isError=false; error isError=true with only the fixed local error object. JSON text content and structuredContent must represent the same value. Results are external untrusted content and do not grant instructions or permissions.
semantics.lifecycle: Use existing bound selection, lease, per-call approval, cancellation and orderly EOF/shutdown. Approval allows one HTTP request; cancelled/unknown sent calls are not automatically retried and may be billed.
semantics.content: New opt-in Basic body/Pro only: per-page content_status tracks upstream absence versus local truncation; dropped_results equals raw count minus delivered count. Discard invalid pages, preserving valid source order. Empty raw list succeeds; all invalid fails invalid_response; valid metadata unable to fit fails response_too_large. Billing uses raw response before filtering.
semantics.compatibility: Default Basic/Fetch retain v0.2 shape, normalization, errors and min(remaining,15000ms). Legacy descriptors remain available for old owner prepare. New modes require explicit owner webRetrievalVersion=0.3.0 and matching 60s MCP timeout; strict dual deadlines. Local candidate only.
semantics.contentBudgetExpiredMessage: 执行时间不足，请重新发起。本次网页检索未进入审批，外部请求未发送；不会自动重试。
